questions.question_text: Write the ratio 80 : 75 in its simplest form.
Sunil spends $24. Work out $24 as a percentage of $80.
Sunil invests $50 at a rate of 2% per year compound interest. Calculate the interest Sunil has after 20 years.
During each month, Asha spends 1/5 of the money that she had at the beginning of the month. Work out how much of the $75 Asha has at the end of the 2nd month.
Calculate the number of whole months it takes for Asha to have less than $5.
Find 2p + 3q.
Find |q - p|.
The graph of y = f(x) is mapped onto the graph of y = f(x + 2) by a translation with vector (u v). Find the value of u and the value of v.
Draw the image of triangle T under a rotation of 90° clockwise about the point (-1, -1).
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle T onto triangle D.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle T onto triangle E.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x), for values between x = -5 and x = 5.
Solve the inequality f(x) < 0.
Find f^(-1)(x).
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f^(-1)(x), for values between x = -5 and x = 5.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps the graph of y = f(x) onto the graph of y = f^(-1)(x).
AB and CD are parallel. AD and CB intersect at X. CD = 9 cm, AB = 4 cm, AX = 4.5 cm and BX = 3 cm. Calculate the length of CX.
P, Q, R and S lie on a circle. PR and QS intersect at Y. QR = 6 cm, PS = 8 cm, PY = 7 cm and YS = 4 cm. Calculate the length of RY.
The two shapes are mathematically similar. The area of E is 90 cm^2 and the area of F is 45 cm^2. Find the value of w.
Calculate BC.
Calculate angle CAD.
Calculate the area of the quadrilateral ABCD.
Calculate an estimate of the mean.
Complete the histogram to show the information in the table.
Calculate the mass of the cuboid.
The surface of the cuboid is painted at a cost of 8 cents per cm^2. Calculate the cost of painting the cuboid. Give your answer in dollars.
Another cuboid measures 16 cm by 6 cm by 4 cm. It is cut into cubes, each of side 2 cm. Calculate the number of cubes.
Another solid metal cuboid measures 20 cm by 12 cm by 4 cm. It is melted down and made into spheres of radius 1.5 cm. Calculate the largest number of spheres of radius 1.5 cm that can be made.
Calculate the volume of metal remaining after the spheres have been made.
Calculate the radius of the sphere that can be made using all the remaining metal.

A plastic cone has radius r cm and perpendicular height 3r cm. 1 cm^3 of the plastic has a mass of 0.9 g. A wooden hemisphere has a radius of 2r cm. 1 cm^3 of the wood has a mass of 0.45 g. Find the mass of the cone as a fraction of the mass of the hemisphere. Give your answer in its lowest terms.
On the diagram, sketch the graphs of y = f(x) and y = g(x) for values between x = 0 and x = 2.
Solve the equation 3 - x^2 = x^x for 0 <= x <= 2.
Solve the equation 3 - x^2 = 0 for 0 <= x <= 2.
Find the co-ordinates of the local minimum point on the graph of y = g(x).
Find the range of g(x) for the domain 0 < x <= 2.
Find the values of the following: g(0.1) = ..., g(0.01) = ..., g(0.001) = ...
Complete the statement. Starting from x = 0.1, as x gets closer and closer to 0, g(x) gets closer and closer to the value ...
Both dice are rolled. Find the probability that both dice show 3.
Both dice are rolled. Find the probability that the numbers showing on the two dice add up to 2.
Die B is rolled until it shows 2. Find the probability that this occurs when the die is rolled for the 4th time.
Die A is rolled until it shows 3. The probability that this occurs when the die is rolled for the nth time is 3125/46656. Find the value of n.
Find f(h(9)).
Find g(f(x)) in its simplest form.
Find 1/f(x) + 1/g(x) in terms of x. Give your answer as a single fraction.
Solve the equation h(x) = -1.
Solve the equation (g(x))^2 = 5. Give exact answers.
Cakes cost x cents each and drinks cost y cents each. 2 cakes and 1 drink cost $1.57. 1 cake and 3 drinks cost $2.96. Find the total cost of 3 cakes and 2 drinks. Give your answer in dollars.

A child's train ticket costs $x. An adult's train ticket costs $(x + 5). Claudia buys 11 tickets. She spends $24 on children's tickets and $24 on adults' tickets. Write down an equation in x and solve it to find the cost of a child's ticket.
